headline: Frontier Energy Secures Federal Agreement Supporting Waroona Funding
summary: Frontier Energy cleared a key hurdle after securing a federal agreement designed to support its Waroona Stage One project until 2042 if revenue falls below an agreed floor.
why: Revenue floor agreements de-risk renewable energy capital projects by providing predictable cash flow guarantees for investors and lenders.

impacts.name: Frontier Energy
impacts.why: A federal revenue floor agreement provides financial security and lowers downside risk for project funding.
